title.en: Why Pinjin main-cylinder seal marks are not one number style
title.zh: 为什么品锦主油缸密封的标记不是同一种写法

description.en: The Xingtai main-cylinder seal page mixes φ63, φ80, crossed marks such as 80×125, a dash mark 90–160, and the kit code 461K. They are separate rows.
description.zh: 邢台主油缸密封页混用 φ63、φ80、80×125 这类乘号标记、连接号 90–160，以及套件代号 461K。它们是分开的行。

h1.en: Main-cylinder seal marks on one Pinjin page
h1.zh: 品锦同一页上的主油缸密封标记

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists eight main-cylinder seal kits. The marks are not interchangeable spellings of one size. No pump model and no service life are printed.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械列出八套主油缸密封。这些标记不是同一尺寸的不同写法。没有印泵型号，也没有印寿命。

body.en: φ63 and φ80 use a diameter mark. 80×125, 90×140, 95×140 and 100×150 use two numbers and a times sign. 90–160 uses a dash. 461K is a kit code. The page does not define the two numbers as bore and rod; it only says to confirm the kit against the cylinder bore and rod.
body.zh: φ63 和 φ80 用直径标记。80×125、90×140、95×140 和 100×150 用两个数字加乘号。90–160 用连接号。461K 是套件代号。页面没有把两个数字定义成缸径和活塞杆，只要求对照油缸缸径和活塞杆核对套件。

heading.en: What a similar number on another page is
heading.zh: 另一页上相近的数字是什么

body.en: φ80 is also a mixing seal, a swing-cylinder seal and an S-tube small-end seal. 100 / 125 mm is a pipe cell on four pumps. None of those is the main-cylinder row 80×125 or 100×150.
body.zh: φ80 同时也是搅拌密封、摆缸密封和 S 管小端密封。100 / 125 mm 是四台泵的管子格子。它们都不是主油缸那一行的 80×125 或 100×150。

body.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Copy one mark only. Say which of the eight rows you checked.
body.zh: 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 只抄一个标记。写明核对的是八行里的哪一行。

answer.en: No. They are two printed rows.
answer.zh: 不是。它们是印出的两行。

answer.en: The page does not expand 461K. Diameter is a missing field for that code.
answer.zh: 页面没有展开 461K。这个代号的直径是缺字段。

answer.en: This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine.
answer.zh: 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。

answer.en: A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank.
answer.zh: 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。

label.en: Email or WhatsApp the Xingtai factory
label.zh: 邮件或 WhatsApp 联系邢台工厂
